title: RepositoryUploadIntentPayload
description: Payload schema for Repository.Upload intents. Each accepted intent mints exactly one Revision under the named Repository. Phase 1 caps the gzipped tarball at 10 MB (10485760 bytes); the byteCount maximum here is the schema-level enforcement of UPLOAD_TOO_LARGE.

byteCount.description: Decoded length of the tarball in bytes; hard cap is 10 MB compressed.

contentHash.description: SHA-256 of the tarball bytes, lowercase hex.
